run_cache_dataset: run the cache_dataset CLI to precompute torsion caches for spice_train, spice_test, or drugs datasets using the fairchem energy model
run_cache_dataset_custom_suffix: run the cache_dataset CLI with a custom torsion cache suffix to cache molecular datasets for adjoint sampling
run_cache_dataset_learn_torsions: run the cache_dataset CLI with the learn_torsions flag enabled to cache datasets with learnable torsion parameters
run_cache_dataset_single: run the cache_dataset CLI on a single dataset like spice_test using the fairchem energy model on CPU
review_cache_dataset: review the cache_dataset CLI script that caches molecular datasets using FairChemEnergy and get_spice_dataset for adjoint sampling workflows
